notes.title: Mini drones overview
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=NZH-sFfiNa0;full][/previewyoutube]
Hey there, gamers! Today, I am super excited to show you the latest upgrade in Starfend that's going to change the way you battle those meteor waves. That's right, we're talking about unlocking mini drones for your cannons!
You know how tough it can get when those meteor waves start rolling in, right? Well, now, things are about to get a whole lot easier. When you reach a certain amount of cannons in the game, you unlock mini drones of that cannon. And let me tell you, these little guys are game-changers.
Imagine having 30 mini drones at your command, each one mirroring the power of your cannons. These little guys fly around and target those meteors like nobody's business.
Let me show you what I mean. As the meteor waves come crashing down, watch how these mini drones swarm around, blasting away those meteors left and right. It's like having your own personal army of defenders!
And unlocking these mini drones is easier than ever. Simply reach a certain amount of cannons, and boom! You've got yourself some mini drone buddies ready to join the fight.
As you progress through the game and unlock more cannons, you'll unlock different types of mini drones, each with its own unique abilities and firepower. It's all about finding the right combination to suit your playstyle.
Now, let's talk about effectiveness. These mini drones aren't just for show. They are incredibly effective at taking down those meteor waves, giving you the edge you need to survive even the toughest levels.
With their rapid-fire attacks and precision targeting, these mini drones make quick work of any meteor that dares to come your way. And trust me, when things get intense, you'll be glad to have them on your side.
So, there you have it, folks! The latest upgrade in Starfend: unlockable mini drones. With 30 mini drones to unlock!

notes.title: Debuf effect and meteor target
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Ml8I5PFDJ6E;full][/previewyoutube]Prepare to elevate your defense tactics with these groundbreaking features:

Drone Target Selection: Take command like never before! Directly select targets for your drones and unleash precision strikes with ease.

Enhanced Meteor Targeting: Engage with precision and efficiency. Click on meteors to assign targets for your cannons, optimizing defensive firepower automatically.

Selective Cannon Targeting: Fine-tune your defense strategy. Individual cannon selection ensures only those within range of the targeted meteor adjust their aim, maximizing effectiveness.

Visual Feedback for Meteor Effects: Stay informed, stay ahead. Clear visual effects signal when meteors are affected by defensive measures, empowering informed decision-making in real-time.

Target Icons for Cannon-Meteor Interactions: Never miss a beat! New target icons provide instant confirmation of your defensive actions, reinforcing your control over the battlefield.

notes.title: Build fleet
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=mhfDr0XMrXE;full][/previewyoutube]In this new update, players will have the opportunity to allocate their hard-earned meteor funds, to assemble their ultimate drone crew. Each drone comes with its own unique set of abilities and strengths, offering endless possibilities for tactical gameplay. But here's the catch: you can only upgrade your drones up to the level you've purchased, so choose wisely!
Once you've assembled your team, it's time to select your main drone, the one you'll personally pilot around the map to fend off those incoming meteors with precision and skill.

notes.title: February 26 Update details
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce a thrilling new update for Starfend! Prepare for even more strategic depth and immersive gameplay with the latest features:

1. Drone Target Selection:
Take command like never before! In this update, players can now directly select targets for their drones. With this new level of control, precision strikes and tactical maneuvers are at your fingertips.

2. Enhanced Meteor Targeting:
Engage with precision and efficiency. Now, players can click on meteors to assign targets for their cannons. If no specific cannon is selected, all cannons within range will automatically aim at the targeted meteor, ensuring maximum defensive firepower.

3. Selective Cannon Targeting:
Fine-tune your defense strategy. When selecting cannons individually, only those within range of the targeted meteor will adjust their aim, optimizing resource allocation and defensive effectiveness.

4. Visual Feedback for Meteor Effects:
Stay informed, stay ahead. With the addition of visual effects, players will now receive clear feedback when meteors are affected by defensive measures such as break defense or slowing effects. This visual feedback enhances immersion and empowers players to make informed decisions in the heat of battle.

5. Target Icons for Cannon-Meteor Interactions:
Never miss a beat! A new target icon now appears on meteors targeted by cannons, providing instant visual confirmation of your defensive actions and reinforcing your control over the battlefield.

With these exciting updates, Starfend delivers a more immersive, strategic, and visually stunning experience than ever before. Dive in and command your defenses like never before!

notes.title: Starfend Update
notes.notes:
In the latest update, players will experience an enhanced tower defense gameplay. At the onset of each match, a randomized path for incoming meteors is generated, showcasing the various types of threats players will face.

Armed with the ability to build and customize their troop, players strategically deploy units to counter the impending meteor onslaught. With the addition of player-controlled drone, the battlefield dynamic shifts, offering a more immersive and engaging experience. Piloting their own drone, players navigate through space, strategically positioning themselves to intercept and destroy meteors before they pass. This update introduces a new layer of tactical depth, challenging players to adapt their strategies and utilize all available resources to emerge victorious against the cosmic threat.
